ruleDefinitions.name: Office Macro File Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a new office macro files on the systems

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\\\.docm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dotm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlsm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xltm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.potm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.pptm$"))
